content: {"summary":"One checkout can generate up to nine calls to the card processor, and the incident stopped after CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS was set to 1.","likely_cause":"A retry multiplier caused each checkout to fan‑out into multiple attempts (up to nine) against the processor, overwhelming it until the retry limit was reduced.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"One checkout can fan out into up to nine processor attempts","evidence_ids":["RB-016#0"],"quote":"That's up to nine attempts against the processor for one button press."},{"text":"Setting CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1 ended the incident","evidence_ids":["RB-016#5"],"quote":"It ended within minutes of setting CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1."}],"next_checks":["Verify the current CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS value in payments‑api ConfigMap","Monitor per‑hop request ratios to ensure they stay near 1:1:1","Check for any remaining CPX-W429 errors on card‑processor‑proxy","Confirm edge‑gateway timeout remains at 15 s and has not been increased"]}
